userStories.title: Correct absent-specSource comment characterization
userStories.description: As a maintainer reading src/issues/spec.ts, I need the comment on the specSource===undefined -> 'interview' resolution to accurately describe it as the live common/default path (not 'back-compat') so that the code documentation matches the CAM-146 PRD notes and does not mislead future readers.
acceptanceCriteria: The two comments on the specSource===undefined -> 'interview' resolution in src/issues/spec.ts (the header-block invariant at line ~70 and the inline note at line ~92) no longer contain the string 'back-compat'. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'back-compat' src/issues/spec.ts]
The corrected comments describe the absent-specSource resolution as the live common/default path (e.g. contain the word 'default'). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'default' src/issues/spec.ts]
No behavior change: only comment text is modified, no code lines in src/issues/spec.ts are altered. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single file: src/issues/spec.ts. Two locations carry the 'back-compat' wording: the invariant-list docblock (line ~70: 'Absent specSource on a stage:specified issue is treated as "interview" (back-compat, passes).') and the inline comment (line ~92: 'Absent specSource is treated as "interview" (back-compat). No error emitted for absence.'). Replace 'back-compat' with wording that states this is the live common/default path (absent specSource is the default, not a legacy compatibility shim), per CAM-146 PRD notes. Comment-only change; do NOT touch logic (the specSource===undefined ? 'interview' resolution on line 93 stays byte-identical). Aligned with the comments-go-stale discipline (patterns.md / lessons.archive.md 2026-06-05). Source: cam/issue-146.
